questions.cardText:
[Political Science] A “constitutional monarchy” is a government where:
A. The monarch has absolute power
B. The monarch’s powers are limited by a constitution
C. Monarchy is symbolic with no real power
Answer: B. Today, constitutional monarchies are mostly ceremonial, with real political power in elected bodies.
questions.de: Wodurch werden in einer konstitutionellen Monarchie die Befugnisse des Monarchen begrenzt?
questions.en: In a constitutional monarchy, what limits the monarch's powers?

timeline.labelEn: England's Bill of Rights restricts the monarchy after the Glorious Revolution
timeline.labelDe: Englands Bill of Rights beschränkt nach der Glorreichen Revolution die Monarchie

questions.cardText:
[Ecology] What unusual effect does global climate change have on sea turtles?
A. It changes their migration patterns
B. It affects their sex ratio
C. It increases their size
Answer: B. The sex of sea turtle hatchlings is determined by the temperature at which the eggs are incubated. Warmer temperatures generally produce more females.
questions.de: Welches Verhältnis unter frisch geschlüpften Meeresschildkröten verschiebt die Erderwärmung, da die Bruttemperatur der Eier das Geschlecht bestimmt?
questions.en: Which ratio among sea turtle hatchlings does global warming shift, since the incubation temperature of the eggs decides each hatchling's sex?

timeline.labelEn: Madeleine Charnier first describes temperature-dependent sex determination, in the lizard Agama agama
timeline.labelDe: Madeleine Charnier beschreibt erstmals die temperaturabhängige Geschlechtsbestimmung, bei der Agame Agama agama
